Interesting Facts
Bergamot is the aromatic citrus fruit of Citrus bergamia; the essential oil is obtained primarily from the peel, traditionally especially in Calabria. Its scent is bright, fresh-citrusy and slightly tart, with green, fruity and gently floral nuances.
